posts.title: BRUTALIST ASIA: TROPICAL CONCRETE, LIQUID STONE
posts.description: Brutalist Asia, the newest title from Blue Crow Media, is a study in both monumentality and detail: the former in the scope of both its featured structures and the staggering scale of the region, the latter in its focused and nuanced examination of regional architectures.
